nodes.text: Default agent delivery for a multi-layer feature lands as one unreviewable PR (~1535 additions / ~1700 narrated).
Stacked PRs + gh-stack decompose into dependency-ordered layers each independently reviewable.
gh extension install github/gh-stack + gh skill install github/gh-stack; skill targets include Copilot and third-party agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, Cline, CodeBuddy, Continue).
Demo stack: catalog-data → search-api → chat-grounding → grounded-ui (PRs #5–#8, Stack #9).
Layer prompts enforce single concern (API-only, no UI; grounding without presentation; presentation separate).
Read stack top-down; review/merge bottom-up. Bottom merge merges only that PR; top can Merge stack.
After downstack push, UI shows Blocked downstack / Not ready + divergence + Unable to merge as a stack; Rebase stack button appears.
gh stack sync --remote clears divergence and restores Able to merge as a stack (demo recovery path).
Web Rebase stack can reset committer and produce unsigned commits under branch protection.
